A Multilinear Interactive Oracle Proof (MIOP) is an IOP that satisfies the following: All messages sent by P are either elements of some finite field F or oracles for evaluations of multilinear polynomials... All messages sent by the verifier are random coin tosses... The verifier accepts or rejects by... only checking polynomial conditions...

HVZK is an interactive honest-verifier notion. Fiat-Shamir, malicious-verifier, and post-quantum/QROM claims must be tied to the exact transcript, hash, and composition theorem, not inferred from a ZK label.
Plonky3's hiding base-case security helper is diagnostic only; a claimed 100-bit end-to-end configuration needs a separate composed soundness and binding budget.
No CVE or GHSA affected/fixed range is relied upon. Cited issues and commits describe feature maturity and protocol cutovers, not vulnerability remediations.
